segments.text: Jay takes Gloria to a comedy show for Valentine’s Day. The comedian keeps making jokes about their age difference, and Jay becomes increasingly uncomfortable. They leave and go salsa dancing instead, choosing something they both actually enjoy.

segments.text: Overall, the episode shows that romance rarely follows a perfect script. The best moments do not come from acting sophisticated. They come from being able to survive an embarrassing situation together and still laugh about it later.
